summary: A circle of parts with a value in the middle, which names a part on hover.

props.name: data
props.description: The parts, in order around the circle. Each draws a lighter step of the fill color, and a fifth and later share the lightest, so fold small parts into "Other".

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers and its table.

props.name: total
props.description: The whole the circle measures against. Without it, the parts fill the circle.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: The large text in the middle, such as a percentage.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: A line under the middle text.

props.name: format
props.description: How a value reads in the middle on hover and in the table.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
